summary:
ABSIDIAN — Survival Is a Decision
ABSIDIAN is an educational space-survival game designed to introduce younger generations to the challenges of space exploration and engineering. Set in 2087, the game follows an engineer recruited to participate in an international mission to establish a sustainable lunar base.
Players are challenged to build and maintain their own settlement while managing limited resources such as oxygen, water, energy, and food. They must make strategic decisions, construct essential infrastructure, and respond to unexpected situations, including solar storms and equipment failures.
Our project combines survival gameplay with scientific concepts, resource management, and problem-solving to make space science more accessible and engaging. It aims to develop critical thinking, teamwork, and decision-making skills while helping players understand the complexity of sustaining human life beyond Earth.
The current version of ABSIDIAN is only a demo that demonstrates our core concept and vision. We plan to further develop and improve it by introducing more advanced gameplay mechanics, interactive 3D environments, realistic space missions, multiplayer features, and more scientifically accurate simulations. Our ultimate goal is to transform this prototype into a complete and immersive educational game.
details:
Project Details — ABSIDIAN: Survival Is a Decision

ABSIDIAN is an educational space-survival simulation game set in 2087. It places players in the role of an engineer participating in an international mission to establish a sustainable human settlement on the Moon.

The game challenges players to build and maintain their own lunar base while working with limited resources. Players must manage oxygen, water, energy, and food, construct essential infrastructure such as habitats and greenhouses, and respond to unexpected challenges, including solar storms, equipment failures, and resource shortages. Every decision can affect the stability of the base and the survival of its crew.

Our project aims to make space exploration, engineering, and sustainability more accessible and engaging, especially for younger audiences. Through interactive missions and resource-management challenges, players can develop critical thinking, problem-solving, teamwork, and responsible decision-making skills. The game demonstrates how scientific knowledge and engineering solutions are essential for sustaining human life beyond Earth.

We were inspired by real challenges of space exploration, including limited resources, radiation exposure, energy generation, water recycling, and life-support systems. We also considered the importance of making complex scientific concepts understandable through gameplay rather than relying on lengthy explanations.

The current version is a demonstration prototype that presents our core concept and initial implementation. We aim to further develop ABSIDIAN into a more advanced and immersive application by improving its gameplay, introducing interactive 3D environments, expanding missions, implementing multiplayer cooperation, and incorporating more realistic scientific simulations and space-related data.

ABSIDIAN combines education, technology, creativity, and exploration to encourage the next generation to think like engineers and understand that survival is ultimately a matter of knowledge, cooperation, and decisions.
